fields.hero_lede: BBMH Hospital is a 100-bedded multispeciality hospital in Cuttack, Odisha, with 50+ doctors. Its front desk, clinical and billing operations now work together through digital workflows, reducing administrative work by 35%.
fields.overview_heading: A growing hospital facing administrative challenges
fields.overview_content:
BBMH provides advanced laboratory and imaging services, ICU care, cath lab services, and multiple clinical and surgical specialities, along with 24×7 emergency services. As its patient volume increased, managing the hospital's internal processes became harder.

Information was spread across paper files, spreadsheets and different systems. Administrative teams spent considerable time searching for information, tracking data and handling follow-ups, while doctors were also pulled into administrative work.
fields.problem_heading: Four challenges affecting BBMH's hospital operations

problems.title: Scattered Information
problems.text: Patient records, billing information and reports were spread across paper files, spreadsheets and different systems, making information harder to find.

problems.title: Manual Workflows
problems.text: Billing and record-keeping involved manual processes and repeated cross-checking, making routine administrative work more time-consuming.

problems.title: Limited Visibility
problems.text: Management did not have timely access to information about hospital activities. Reports took time to compile, making it harder to get a clear view of operations.

problems.title: Administrative Burden
problems.text: Internal coordination and follow-ups were taking doctors and teams away from their core responsibilities.

fields.decision_intro: BBMH needed to move away from scattered records and manual processes while keeping billing, patient information and reporting connected. It chose Healthray HMS to centralise these workflows, reduce administrative follow-ups and give teams faster access to operational information.
fields.quote_text: Moving to Healthray made the shift to digital hospital management much easier for us. Our existing data was migrated smoothly, and our teams moved to the new system without disrupting hospital operations.
fields.solution_heading: How Healthray helped BBMH digitise operations

solutions.title: Centralised hospital information
solutions.text: Healthray's Patient Records module brought patient information into one digital system, reducing the need to search across paper files, spreadsheets and separate sources.

solutions.title: Digital billing
solutions.text: The Billing module reduced manual data handling and helped teams process billing and discharge activities faster.

solutions.title: Faster operational reporting
solutions.text: Reporting tools gave teams and management quicker access to hospital information instead of relying on manually compiled reports.

solutions.title: Better task coordination
solutions.text: Staff & Task Management helped teams organise follow-ups and routine activities digitally, reducing manual coordination.

fields.setup_heading: From data migration to team onboarding
fields.setup_intro: BBMH moved to Healthray without disrupting its ongoing hospital operations.

steps.title: Data migration
steps.text: BBMH's existing data was migrated to Healthray within one day.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.text: Healthray HMS went live within two weeks without disrupting hospital operations.

steps.title: Teams onboarded
steps.text: Doctors and teams were onboarded to Healthray and its digital workflows.

fields.results_intro: The move to digital hospital management delivered measurable improvements at BBMH.

results.title: reduction in administrative workload
results.text: Reduced manual tracking, follow-ups and routine administrative work helped lower the overall workload.

results.title: faster billing and discharge processing
results.text: Digital billing workflows helped streamline billing and discharge activities.

results.title: fewer manual errors
results.text: Reducing manual data handling and repeated cross-checking helped improve accuracy.

results.title: faster access to operational information
results.text: Digital access to hospital information gave teams and management a clearer view of hospital activities and processes.
